name: A + B Strikes Back
description: A + B is often used as an example of the easiest problem possible to show some contest platform. However, some scientists have observed that sometimes this problem is not so easy to get accepted. Want to try?
input_specification: The input contains two integers a and b ( 0 ≤ a , b ≤ 10 3 ), separated by a single space.
output_specification: Output the sum of the given integers.
approach_summary: Maintain disjoint sets using path compression and union by rank/size. Process edge additions and component queries in O(α(N)) amortized time.
